rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296F12700000000}Ghh, what happened?
Rie, Nelfea,
is everyone all right?


{C:81900300}{C:81958296F22700000000}There's no damage to the ship.
Nelfea, where are we?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F32700000000}The continent nearby is...
{C:819782830300}the Terra continent{C:819782830000}?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F42700000000}We drifted all the way to Terra?

{C:8190A302}{C:81958296F62700000000}The Cloud Sea's currents have shifted.
We can't reach anywhere but the Terra continent.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296F72700000000}Then that's convenient.
I'd like to know what's happening on Terra too.
Could you take us down?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F82700000000}Yes, Lieutenant Quattro.
The Astante is entering the Terra continent.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81938A00}{C:81958296F92700000000}Can you hear me?
This is Amuro Ray.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FA2700000000}Amuro!

{C:81938A00}{C:81958296FB2700000000}{C:819782830300}Von Braun{C:819782830000} is where I'll be waiting.
I'm looking forward
to seeing you all again.

{C:81958296FC2700000000}Especially you, Kamille.
I have something to give you,
so look forward to it.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296FD2700000000}Understood. Von Braun, then.
We'll head there right away.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8193B800}{C:81958296FE2700000000}{C:819782830400}Haman{C:819782830000}, ma'am!
Are you truly going?

{C:81939E00}{C:81958296FF2700000000}I have to go.
If this concerned Terra alone,
I would ignore it too.

{C:81958296002800000000}But I simply cannot bear
letting that man have his way.

{C:8193B800}{C:81958296012800000000}But, {C:819782830400}Haman{C:819782830000}, ma'am, you needn't
go in person...

{C:81939E00}{C:81958296022800000000}Oh, there's no need to worry.
I'll be putting Char to work too.

{C:81958296032800000000}{C:819782830400}Mineva{C:819782830000} is to be told that urgent business
will keep me away for a while.

{C:81958296042800000000}{C:819782830400}Qubeley{C:819782830000} is to be brought out.
Haman Karn is moving out!!





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81908A00}{C:81958296052800000000}Over here!
You look well.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296062800000000}You too, Amuro.
I'm relieved to see you looking well.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296072800000000}Welcome back, Lieutenant Quattro.
You too, Kamille.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296082800000000}I'm glad you're safe.

{C:81958296092800000000}By the way, what's the current situation
on Terra?

{C:81908A00}{C:819582960A2800000000}The Titans are no longer under {C:819782830400}Jamitov{C:819782830000}'s
control. Someone else
has taken charge.

{C:81908700}{C:819582960C2800000000}Jamitov isn't in charge?!
Who controls the Titans now? Is it 
{C:819782830400}Bask Om{C:819782830000}?

{C:81908A00}{C:819582960D2800000000}No, neither of them.
{C:819782830400}Paptimus Scirocco{C:819782830000} is the name of a man
who's been rising to power.

{C:819582960E2800000000}Perhaps that's why the Titans
have been growing more powerful.
You'd better be careful.

{C:81908200}{C:819582960F2800000000}So, Amuro,
what was it
you wanted to give me?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296102800000000}It should already be aboard,
so shall we head to the Astante?







{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296172800000000}Come to think of it, how's it going, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296182800000000}How's what going?
You can't just spring that on me
and expect me to know how to answer.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296192800000000}Sorry, sorry.
I mean, how are you doing
as captain?

{C:81900300}{C:819582961A2800000000}I know what it means to be captain,
but I have no idea
whether I'm doing a good job.

{C:81908900}{C:819582961B2800000000}So you're Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:819582961C2800000000}Yes?

{C:81908900}{C:819582961D2800000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Henken Bekkener{C:819782830000}.
I captain a battleship for AEUG.

{C:819582961E2800000000}I'll be boarding the Astante
to help you this time.
I'm looking forward to working with you.

{C:81900300}{C:819582961F2800000000}I'm looking forward to working with you too.
But, Henken,
shouldn't you be the captain?

{C:81908900}{C:81958296202800000000}I only know my way around Terra.
You have more experience.

{C:81958296212800000000}Just think of me as someone
you can turn to when you're in trouble.
Well, I'll head to the Astante first.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296222800000000}Yes.
Please let me come to you for advice.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296232800000000}Isn't that great, Rie?
If they're keeping you as captain,
it means they recognize your abilities.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296242800000000}Nobody's complained.
They trust you, so have some confidence.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296252800000000}Yeah.
I feel a little more confident now.




{x00}

{C:81934202}{C:81958296372800000000}{C:819782830400}Scott{C:819782830000}, they're catching up!

{C:81934302}{C:81958296382800000000}Can't this thing go any faster?

{C:81934402}{C:81958296392800000000}You can say that, but
unless we escape into the Cloud Sea,
there's no way out!


{x00}

{C:8193EC01}{C:819582963A2800000000}You're certain of that?

{C:8193ED01}{C:819582963B2800000000}Judging by the call for help
we intercepted a moment ago,
there's no mistake.

{C:819582963C2800000000}The only people aboard that ship
are children.

{C:8193EC01}{C:819582963D2800000000}I see...
Then there's no need for further attacks.
{C:819782830400}Lady{C:819782830000}, withdraw.

{C:8193ED01}{C:819582963E2800000000}Understood, {C:819782830400}Treize{C:819782830000}.


{x00}

{C:81934B02}{C:819582963F2800000000}Huh?
Big brother, the enemy ship's turning back?

{C:81934302}{C:81958296402800000000}Now that's lucky.
Right, boss?

{C:81934502}{C:81958296A40000000000}Wait!
Another ship on the radar...


{x00}

{C:81908400}{C:81958296442800000000}You're back at just the right time.
It seems a ship carrying only children
is under attack.

{C:81958296452800000000}Rie says
she wants to go to their rescue.
Get back to the Astante immediately.

{C:81934402}{C:819582964A2800000000}Is that really true?

{C:81934202}{C:819582964B2800000000}Try answering them first.

{C:81934402}{C:819582964D2800000000}Y-yeah.

{C:819582964E2800000000}This is the {C:819782830400}Janus.{C:819782830000}
Are you telling the truth
about not intending to attack?

{x00}

{C:81930300}{C:819582964F2800000000}Lieutenant Quattro, please take over.

{C:81938400}{C:81958296512800000000}I'm Lieutenant Quattro of AEUG.
We've also confirmed
that only children are aboard your ship.

{C:81958296532800000000}We'd like to take you under our protection, if possible.
Could you come
to Von Braun?

{x00}

{C:81934402}{C:81958296542800000000}After what they said,
maybe we can trust them?

{C:81934302}{C:81958296552800000000}What do you think, boss?

{C:81934202}{C:81958296572800000000}There's no way to escape.
Let's trust them for now.

{C:81934402}{C:81958296582800000000}Understood.
We'll head for Von Braun.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81908400}{C:81958296592800000000}Now it makes sense.
The Titans want
to get their hands on your RVs.

{C:81904202}{C:819582965B2800000000}Why do they want the RVs?

{C:81930100}{C:819582965C2800000000}I think the enemy wants
any extra fighting strength it can get,
especially now that we're back.

{C:81904302}{C:819582965D2800000000}Because you're back?

{C:819582965F2800000000}Oh, so you're the people
who've been fighting
as you travel between continents!

{C:81904202}{C:81958296602800000000}Oh, you're the people from that story!
We did it, Scott!
We're safe now!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296612800000000}What story is that?

{C:81904502}{C:81958296A50000000000}We heard there were people
fighting against
Posaydal's army.

{C:81958296A70000000000}They said we'd be safe
if we got those people to help us.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296622800000000}Ah!!
Weren't you all supposed
to stay hidden?!!

{C:81904A02}{C:81958296632800000000}We were hiding.
But they found us,
so what could we do?

{C:81905700}{C:81958296642800000000}Oh, I see. Sorry.
Still, I'm glad we've joined up.

{C:81904602}{C:81958296652800000000}We owe that to you too, Leccee.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296672800000000}So, what will happen to these children?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296682800000000}I intend to have AEUG take them into protective care.

{C:81904202}{C:81958296692800000000}Please wait!
Let me fight alongside you too.
I want to protect everyone.

{C:81904302}{C:819582966A2800000000}Well, if the boss is fighting,
I guess I'll join the fight too.

{C:81904A02}{C:819582966B2800000000}Then I'll fight too.

{C:81904402}{C:819582966C2800000000}{C:819782830400}Roddy{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Barts!{C:819782830000}
This is fighting we're talking about. It's dangerous!

{C:81904302}{C:819582966D2800000000}That's no different from what we've been through.
Anyway, we're going.

{C:81904B02}{C:819582966E2800000000}Big brother, I... I...
I don't wanna be apart from you!

{C:81900300}{C:819582966F2800000000}Then why don't you all come with us?
There's quite a crowd aboard the Astante now,
so we need some help.

{C:81904402}{C:81958296702800000000}What?!
Is that really all right?!

{C:81908400}{C:81958296712800000000}I suppose there's no helping it.
AEUG will look after
the Janus.

{C:81905700}{C:81958296722800000000}Even you, Lieutenant Quattro?
This isn't a game!!

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296732800000000}It was Leccee, wasn't it?
Heh, there's nothing we can do.
It's an order from Rie, the captain.

{C:81904502}{C:81958296A80000000000}Thank you very much.



{x00}

{C:81931A00}{C:81958296A90000000000}Does anyone there know someone called {C:819782830400}Char{C:819782830000}?
Any of you can answer.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296742800000000}This is Quattro.
What's this about all of a sudden, Sho?

{C:81931A00}{C:81958296AA0000000000}We've received a message from someone called Haman.
{C:819782830300}Hong Kong City{C:819782830000} is where
she wants us to go.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296752800000000}Haman...
Haman Karn?
Why now...?

{C:81958296762800000000}Rie,
I'm sorry, but could you take us
to Hong Kong City?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296772800000000}I don't mind,
but do you know her?

{C:81908400}{C:81958296782800000000}I've known her for a long time.
Though she's someone
I'd rather not see.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296792800000000}Understood.
I'll set the Astante's course
for Hong Kong City.

{C:819582967A2800000000}All right, everyone!
Get ready, we're departing!!



{x00}

{x00}

Please give me a moment.

{C:81908400}{C:819582967F2800000000}Yes, of course.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296802800000000}Four!
Thank goodness, you're alive!


{C:81909500}{C:81958296812800000000}Who are you?
You're creepy... Get lost!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296822800000000}Four, it's me.
Don't you remember?
Then do you remember Kamille?!

{C:81909500}{C:81958296832800000000}Kami...lle?
Aah! My head... It hurts!

{C:81958296842800000000}Get lost!
When you're here, it feels like a snake
is writhing around inside my head.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296852800000000}I'm sorry...

{x00}

{C:81908400}{C:81958296862800000000}What happened?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296872800000000}Lieutenant, do you remember
the Psyco Gundam?


{C:81908400}{C:81958296882800000000}If I remember correctly,
it was the MS that gave us a chance
to venture onto the Cloud Sea?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296892800000000}Its pilot
was alive.

{C:81908400}{C:819582968A2800000000}You're saying she escaped that explosion?

{C:819582968B2800000000}But we have no time to pry into that now.
We must find Haman quickly.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968C2800000000}You're right.
Let's hurry.



{x00}

{C:81909E00}{C:819582968D2800000000}Over here, Char.
Or would the name {C:819782830400}Casval{C:819782830000}
be more to your liking?

{C:81930100}{C:819582968E2800000000}So you're Char,
Lieutenant Quattro?

{C:81908400}{C:819582968F2800000000}I'm Quattro Bajeena.
You must use words correctly.

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296902800000000}It makes no difference to me either way.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296912800000000}So, what have you come here for,
Haman Karn?

{C:81909E00}{C:81958296922800000000}This isn't the place.
Let's go somewhere else.

{C:81958296932800000000}Boy, I'm sorry, but could you return
to the ship alone?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296942800000000}Understood.

rows.en:
{C:81939E00}{C:81958296962800000000}Well done on your infiltration of the Federation.
How long has it been since we met face to face?

{C:81938400}{C:81958296972800000000}...
What's brought this on?

{C:81939E00}{C:81958296982800000000}We haven't seen each other in so long,
and that's what you say to me, Char?

{C:81958296992800000000}Well, never mind.
I've come because I refuse to let that man
do as he pleases with Terra.

{C:81938400}{C:819582969A2800000000}That man?
You mean the man called Scirocco
who's taken control of the Titans?

{C:81939E00}{C:819582969B2800000000}The man behind this war.
I have no intention of acting
according to his designs.

{C:81938400}{C:819582969C2800000000}That's just like you, Haman.

{C:81939E00}{C:819582969D2800000000}Of course.
That's why I left {C:819782830300}Axis{C:819782830000}
and came here.







{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582969E2800000000}Oh, there you are!
Kamille!!

{C:81908200}{C:819582969F2800000000}Welcome back.
What's happened? Why are you in such a hurry?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A02800000000}I saw Four on Main Street.


{C:81908200}{C:81958296A12800000000}Even you should know there are things
you can say and things you can't!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A22800000000}I'm telling the truth!
But she didn't
remember you, Kamille...

{C:81908200}{C:81958296A32800000000}Four... Four is alive?
Where was she?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A42800000000}I don't know where she went
after we parted on Main Street. Sorry.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296A52800000000}I'm going to find Four!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A62800000000}Kamille! Kamille!!


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296AB0000000000}What happened? Kamille just
rushed out in the Zeta Gundam?!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A72800000000}The person who helped us
might still be alive,
so he went looking for her.

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296A82800000000}Are you being drawn to her, Kamille?
I just hope you don't end up
like we did...

{C:81908400}{C:81958296A92800000000}Has something happened to Kamille?

{C:81908A00}{C:81958296AA2800000000}Oh, Char.
Kamille took the Zeta Gundam
to look for Four.

{C:81958296AB2800000000}We'd better find him
before something goes wrong.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD2800000000}Understood.
I'll go tell Rie.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81909B00}{C:81958296AE2800000000}A rat has slipped into our continent.
Will you exterminate it, {C:819782830400}Jerid Messa{C:819782830000}?

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296AF2800000000}Of course.
I intend to repay you
for taking me in.

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296B02800000000}I'm counting on you to keep your word.

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296B12800000000}Leave it to me.
I'm heading out.

{C:81909200}{C:81958296B22800000000}Then I'll come too.

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296B32800000000}Wait, {C:819782830400}Mouar.{C:819782830000}

{C:81908F00}{C:81958296B42800000000}I'll go on ahead.


{x00}

{C:81909B00}{C:81958296B52800000000}A grown woman should be with a grown man.
Unless you prefer dealing with little boys.

{C:81958296B62800000000}I am the only man
who can fulfill your ambitions.
You'd do well to remember that.

{C:81909200}{C:81958296B72800000000}(What a man...)



{x00}

{C:81938400}{C:81958296B82800000000}Have you found anything out?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296B92800000000}He apparently went in 
{C:819782830300}Von Braun{C:819782830000}'s direction,
according to a message from Karaba.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BA2800000000}Then let's head
to Von Braun.

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296BB2800000000}Honestly, that boy!
He's always doing whatever he pleases.
I'll have to tell him off when he gets back!



{x00}

{C:8193A002}{C:81958296BF2800000000}Stop it, Hime!

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296C02800000000}You need to stop
acting so selfishly!

{C:81958296C12800000000}Do you have any idea
how much trouble you're causing everyone?

{C:81938200}{C:81958296C22800000000}You... What would
you know about it?!!

{C:8193A002}{C:81958296C32800000000}That's right, Hime.
If you were in Kamille's position,
could you say the same thing?

{C:81958296C42800000000}Could you, Hime?!

{C:8193A102}{C:81958296C52800000000}Uuuugh...


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81908A00}{C:81958296C62800000000}Kamille.
The way you're being drawn to her is dangerous.

{C:81958296C72800000000}If you go on like this,
you'll go through the same suffering
that Lieutenant Quattro and I once did!

{C:81905600}{C:81958296C82800000000}Kamille, you like
this Four, don't you?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296C92800000000}It's not about love or anything like that.
I have to get her out.

{C:81958296CA2800000000}We've finally learned that {C:819782830300}Kilimanjaro{C:819782830000} is
where she is!!

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296CB2800000000}After everything he's said,
can't you let him go?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CE2800000000}Chirico?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296CF2800000000}I understand how Kamille feels.
...At least, I think I do.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296D32800000000}I'm asking you too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D42800000000}I thought you'd say that, Lun.

{C:81958296D52800000000}Kamille, you'll have to go to Kilimanjaro
alone.
Is that all right?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296D62800000000}I'll go even if I have to go alone!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296D82800000000}But... all alone?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D92800000000}Everyone else,
please help lure the enemy
above Kilimanjaro.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296DA2800000000}Big brother!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296DB2800000000}You're so coool!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DD2800000000}I can be, sometimes.

{C:81958296DE2800000000}Once you've brought Four out,
rejoin us immediately.
Don't forget, Kamille.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296DF2800000000}Yeah, I understand.
...Thank you.

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296E02800000000}Kamille, I'm sorry I hit you.
I'll help too.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296E12800000000}Don't worry about it, Hime.
If our positions were reversed,
I'm sure I'd have done the same as you.

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296E22800000000}Heh heh, then
let's get going!!

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296E32800000000}Wait a moment!
I'm a ninja,
so sneaking in is my specialteee!!

{C:81958296E42800000000}Kamille, take me with youuu!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E52800000000}It's dangerous for a child to go.

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296E62800000000}It'll be fine, it'll be fine.

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296E72800000000}Enough, Himiko. Keep quiet.

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296E82800000000}We shouldn't waste time.
Let's get moving.




{x00}

{C:81908200}{C:81958296F52800000000}Four!



{C:81909500}{C:81958296F62800000000}Kamille!


{C:81909500}{C:81958296F82800000000}Kamille! Kamille!!

{C:81908200}{C:81958296F92800000000}Four, come with us.
You can't stay here.

{C:81909500}{C:81958296FA2800000000}Yeah, if that's what you say, Kamille,
then I will.

{C:8190E201}{C:81958296FB2800000000}There's no time to relax
and enjoy your reunion.
They're in trouble up above.

{C:8190E501}{C:81958296FC2800000000}We've secured an escape route.
Hurry along.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296FD2800000000}Thank you very much!

{C:8190E401}{C:81958296FE2800000000}We've taken control of most of Kilimanjaro.

{C:81958296FF2800000000}Pass that on to Trowa and the others.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296032900000000}I'm back.

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296AC0000000000}I'm glad you're safe.
So, that young lady
is Four?

{C:81908200}{C:81958296042900000000}Yes.
Her name's Four Murasame.

{C:81958296052900000000}Oh, Trowa!
{C:819782830400}Doctor S{C:819782830000} asked me
to give you his regards.

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296AD0000000000}I see...

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296062900000000}Oh, man. So the old guys
are here too?

{C:81909500}{C:81958296072900000000}They said they'd make sure
we could enter Kilimanjaro.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296092900000000}I'm glad it worked out, Kamille.

{C:81905700}{C:819582960A2900000000}Sorry to interrupt
your happy reunion, but the enemy's coming.

{C:81958296142900000000}Other matters are none of my concern.
